persona: Senior incident handler at a bank, CISSP, aiming for SOC manager
resumeText:
Rajesh Menon | Mumbai | rajesh.menon@example.com

EXPERIENCE
Deputy Manager, Security Operations, Konkan Cooperative Bank, Mumbai (2019 - present)
- Lead a team of 9 SOC analysts across three shifts; hired 4 and run monthly coaching sessions.
- Incident commander for 12 major incidents including a card-skimming malware outbreak.
- Own the QRadar use-case library and retired 40 noisy rules.
- Measured detection coverage against MITRE ATT&CK and closed 18 coverage gaps.
- Prepare CERT-In incident reports within 6 hours and RBI cyber security framework compliance evidence.
- Present the monthly cyber risk dashboard to the CISO and the IT steering committee.
- Work with branch operations, legal and the fraud team during incidents.

Security Analyst, Deccan Infotech Services, Pune (2014 - 2019)
- Monitored client networks and handled phishing and malware incidents.

EDUCATION
MCA, University of Mumbai, 2014

CERTIFICATIONS
CISSP (2020), GCIH (2018)
